summary.zh: 查看并更新站点页面内容
summary.en: Inspect and update site page content

description.zh: 读取站点页面结构与文案，按需生成和修改内容，确认后再发布。适合维护营销页或作品集。首次连接在浏览器登录 Framer 授权。
description.en: Read page structure and copy, then draft or adjust content and publish when it looks right. Useful for maintaining marketing pages or a portfolio. Sign in to Framer in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 Framer 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to Framer and authorize on first connect
